wiki.title: Orbital compute — launch economics and the cost gap
wiki.lede: **Claim under test:** orbital data centres become cost-competitive with terrestrial ones when launch reaches ~$200/kg. Every optimist case (Google, SpaceX, Starcloud) rests on that number; every sceptic case shows how far away it is. The binding constraint is **launch cadence and tonnage**, not physics — and today's demonstrated reality is two orders of magnitude short.
